question: Should this PR land as the combined includeFamily plus reset-family carryover stack, or should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90239 land first and this PR rebase, and is the default-off archived-context provider-boundary opt-in acceptable?
rationale: Automation can verify the bounded resolver, tests, and proof, but it cannot choose the permanent stack order or decide whether archived reset summaries may enter provider-bound prompts under an experimental config.

options.title: Land base first, then rebase carryover
options.body: Finish https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90239 as the canonical includeFamily base, rebase this PR onto it, and keep exact-head proof for the narrower carryover change.

options.title: Accept the combined stack
options.body: Treat this PR as the combined landing path if maintainers accept the public selector, session lineage writes, and default-off provider-boundary behavior together.

options.title: Defer carryover
options.body: Land the lower-risk family-history retrieval path and pause or close this PR if archived-context prompt injection is not desired yet.

recommendation.title: Land base first, then rebase carryover
recommendation.body: Finish https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90239 as the canonical includeFamily base, rebase this PR onto it, and keep exact-head proof for the narrower carryover change.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest explicit project-routing signal and was already called into the PR discussion for the stack/provider-boundary decision.
